name: team_planning_drift
description: Get the drift of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: every change the Org Graph learned from the plan's base date to today (UTC days), whatever day it took effect, in effective date order, as org_graph_changes_between by "learned" gives them. Each change carries `meets`, the plan's latest change to the facet it moves, one per scenario that holds one (a scenario_id equal to the plan_id is the baseline), and `from_plan`, true when the change was applied from this plan. A person's placements are one facet, so a move in one placement meets the plan's whole list. People are named by id, and `names` maps every person id the changes name to a name; a forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
